params.caption: 🏆 Fluxo reportedly pausing its CS2 division Brazilian organisation Fluxo is set to put its Counter-Strike division on hold, according to sources cited by HLTV. Members of the current roster will either be released or moved to the bench, leaving another Brazilian lineup without a home. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 17:11 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV #CS2 #Esports #GamingNews
